changes.comment: Fix watch mode (`heft test-watch`) failing on Jest 30 with "Cannot find module '@jest/core/build/watch.js'". Heft now drives watch mode and reruns the test suite through Jest's public `runCLI` API when files under the Jest `roots` change, ignoring paths that match `modulePathIgnorePatterns` or `watchPathIgnorePatterns`. Each rerun runs the full test suite, and Jest's interactive watch keys and `watchPlugins` are no longer used in watch mode.
